meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会扫描项目里没被引用的代码(未使用的导入、常量、函数、参数、孤立文件),用 LSP 引用查询逐项复核,再派多个并行 agent 分批删除;每批通过类型检查后各自提交一个 commit,最后给出删除汇总表。
howto.when: 当你提到「remove dead code」「cleanup」「remove unused」等关键词时触发;也可以在指令里给出文件路径、目录或符号名来缩小扫描范围。

say.text: 帮我清理这个项目里的死代码
say.note: 会先扫描并复核,确认后才删除

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下的未使用代码
say.note: 给出目录会缩小扫描范围

say.text: 删掉 src/foo.ts 里没用到的导入
say.note: 改动会在类型检查通过后提交

howto.what_en: Claude scans for unreferenced code (unused imports, constants, functions, orphaned files), verifies each with LSP reference checks, then has parallel agents remove them in atomic commits after typecheck passes, and reports a summary.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "remove dead code", "cleanup", or "remove unused"; you can also name a file, directory, or symbol to narrow the scan.

say_en.text: Clean up the dead code in this project.
say_en.note: It scans and verifies before removing.

say_en.text: Only remove unused code under src/utils.
say_en.note: A directory narrows the scan scope.

say_en.text: Delete the unused imports in src/foo.ts.
say_en.note: Changes are committed after typecheck passes.
